'''BestCrypt''', developed by [https://www.jetico.com/ Jetico], is a commercial [[disk encryption software|disk encryption app]] available for [[Microsoft Windows|Windows]], [[Linux]], [[macOS]] and [[Android (operating system)|Android]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jetico.com/data-encryption|title=Data Encryption {{!}} Jetico|website=www.jetico.com|language=en|access-date=2020-02-17}}</ref> 

BestCrypt comes in two editions: BestCrypt Volume Encryption to encrypt entire [[disk volume]]s;<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jetico.com/data-encryption/encrypt-hard-drives-bestcrypt-volume-encryption|title=Encrypt Hard Drives with BestCrypt Volume Encryption {{!}} Jetico|website=www.jetico.com|language=en|access-date=2020-02-17}}</ref> BestCrypt Container Encryption to encrypt [[disk image|virtual disks]] stored as computer files.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jetico.com/data-encryption/encrypt-files-bestcrypt-container-encryption|title=Encrypt Files with BestCrypt Container Encryption {{!}} Jetico|website=www.jetico.com|language=en|access-date=2020-02-17}}</ref> 

BestCrypt also provides the complimentary [[data erasure]] utility [[BCWipe]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jetico.com/data-encryption/encrypt-files-bestcrypt-container-encryption/features|title=BestCrypt Container Encryption Features {{!}} Jetico|website=www.jetico.com|language=en|access-date=2020-02-17}}</ref>

==Cryptographic Algorithms==
BestCrypt supports a wide variety of block cipher algorithms including [[Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]], [[Serpent (cipher)|Serpent]], [[Blowfish (cipher)|Blowfish]], [[Twofish]],  [[Data Encryption Standard|DES]], [[Triple DES]], [[GOST 28147-89]]. All ciphers support [[Block cipher modes of operation#Cipher-block chaining (CBC)|CBC]] and [[Disk_encryption_theory#Liskov,_Rivest,_and_Wagner_(LRW)|LRW]] modes of operation while AES, Twofish and Serpent also support [[XTS mode|XTS]] mode.

==Features==
* Create and mount a [[RAM drive|virtual drive]] encrypted using [[Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]], [[Blowfish (cipher)|Blowfish]], [[Twofish]], [[CAST-128]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jetico.com/web_help/bc8/html/03_new_features/01_new_features.htm|title=New Features in BestCrypt Version 8|publisher=Jetico|accessdate=2014-04-15}}</ref> and various other encryption methods. BestCrypt v.8 and higher can alternatively mount a subfolder on a [[NTFS]] disk instead of a drive. Encrypted virtual disk images are compatible across Windows, Linux and Mac OS X.
* Encrypt a set of files into a single, self-extracting archive. 
* Transparently encrypt entire partitions or volumes together with pre-boot authentication for encrypted boot partitions.
* [[Two-factor authentication]].
* Support for size-efficient Dynamic Containers with the Smart Free Space Monitoring technology.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jetico.com/web_help/bc9/html/03_new_features/01_new_features.htm|title=New Features in BestCrypt Version 9|publisher=Jetico Inc. Oy|accessdate=2015-02-04}}</ref>
* Hardware accelerated encryption.
* Anti-keylogging facilities to protect container and volume passwords.
* [[Data erasure]] utility [[BCWipe]] to erase unprotected copies of data to complement encryption.
* [[Secret sharing]] and [[Public-key cryptography|Public Key]] authentication methods in addition to basic password-based authentication.
